parent_stage2_decision.consequence: AdaptiveK remains executable but is not presented as a validated real-time mode.

research_question: At which registered resource-task scales and wall-clock budgets does a fixed-K interruptible CA-HMCD decision path return feasible allocations on time while the complete-pool HiGHS path misses the same deadline, without exceeding the registered quality-loss limits?
independent_unit: one deterministic seeded static decision snapshot

design.execution: single-process sequential execution after one excluded warm-up unit
design.method_order: Exact first for even seed offsets and bounded-K12 first for odd seed offsets.
design.budget_order: The four budgets are deterministically rotated by seed offset.

CA-HMCD-Exact.candidate_policy: complete pool; no compatibility screen, dominance pruning, or diversity pruning
CA-HMCD-Exact.reference_rule: A seed is an exact quality reference only when HiGHS returns optimal status.

CA-HMCD-BoundedK12-Candidate.candidate_policy: Stage-9 fixed K=12 with compatibility screening where already defined, corrected dominance pruning, and diversity retention
CA-HMCD-BoundedK12-Candidate.solver: interruptible retained-pool branch-and-bound with a greedy feasible warm start
CA-HMCD-BoundedK12-Candidate.deadline_rule: The solver receives only the remaining registered wall-clock budget after candidate generation.

gate_b.decision: PASS if at least one registered scale-budget cell satisfies every criterion; otherwise FAIL.
gate_b.claim_boundary: A PASS validates only the fixed-K12 bounded mode in the passing cells. It does not reverse Stage-2 Gate A or validate AdaptiveK.

statistical_plan.multiplicity: Holm step-down correction within each endpoint-by-budget family over the 16 registered scale cells
statistical_plan.quality_pairing: quality comparisons use only seeds with an optimal HiGHS reference; the gate still requires 30/30 optimal references in a passing cell
